title: Noir Chiaroscuro
description: Photographie monochrome très contrastée rappelant le film noir des années 1940. Caractérisée par un éclairage clair-obscur dramatique, des contre-jours marqués, une brume atmosphérique et une faible profondeur de champ avec un bokeh prononcé.
description_en: High-contrast monochrome photography reminiscent of 1940s film noir. Features dramatic chiaroscuro lighting, strong rim lights, atmospheric haze, and shallow depth of field with pronounced bokeh.
description_fr: Photographie monochrome très contrastée rappelant le film noir des années 1940. Caractérisée par un éclairage clair-obscur dramatique, des contre-jours marqués, une brume atmosphérique et une faible profondeur de champ avec un bokeh prononcé.
prompt: High-contrast black and white cinematic photography, silver gelatin print aesthetic. Apply this style to the complete scene described by {{subject}}, preserving its factual content, camera angle, framing, spatial layout, and stated exclusions. The image must occupy the absolute entire dedicated space, no borders, no frames, full bleed to all four corners. Dramatic chiaroscuro lighting setup. Strong, brilliant rim light and backlighting separating the focal point from the background. Soft, diffused key light illuminating primary details, falling off rapidly into deep, crushed blacks. Monochromatic palette using intense {{primary_color}} blacks, glowing {{accent_color}} whites, and smooth {{secondary_color}} mid-gray transitions. Fine photographic film grain. Thick atmospheric haze or smoke catching the light. Halation around bright light sources. Extremely shallow depth of field. Foreground elements are tack-sharp where light hits, while edges gently fade into shadow. Background elements are heavily blurred, featuring large, luminous circular bokeh effects. Vintage 35mm lens characteristics with slight optical softness at the extremities. The tonal range spans from absolute void-like shadows to blown-out specular highlights. Edges of the primary focal points are sculpted entirely by intense edge-lighting rather than drawn lines. The spatial dynamics rely on forced separation between the crisp, illuminated focal plane and the murky, undefined background.
